stories.title: INS Trishul arrives at Toulon for 24th Exercise VARUNA
stories.body: the Indian Navy's guided-missile stealth frigate arrived in Toulon, France, on 22 Sept 2026 for the 24th edition of the bilateral maritime exercise with the French Navy (inception: 2001); the drill features harbour and sea-phase engagements — cross-deck visits, operational interactions and sporting activities — aimed at interoperability; the deployment follows a 14–17 Sept port call at Alexandria, Egypt, with a PASSEX alongside ENS Bernees.

stories.title: Yudh Abhyas 2026: US Ambassador Sergio Gor witnesses the drill
stories.body: the US envoy reached Rajasthan to witness the 22nd edition of the India–US joint exercise, under way at Mahajan Field Firing Range (Rajasthan) and across Uttarakhand; Indian and US troops have already conducted joint artillery drills with M777 howitzers, Dhanush guns, Pinaka MBRLs and M-LIDS.

stories.title: CDS stresses integration of technology, data and industry
stories.body: Chief of Defence Staff General N.S. Raja Subramani emphasised that integration of technology, data and industry is central to strengthening India's defence ecosystem.

stories.title: SEBI Board approves sweeping reforms at 215th meeting (24 Sept)
stories.body: the board in Mumbai cleared: the new SEBI (Portfolio Managers) Regulations, 2026 replacing the 2020 framework (PMS may invest in IPOs, primary-market debt and overseas securities; a new mutual-fund-only PMS with ~₹25 lakh minimum investment vs ₹50 lakh); wider FPI access to non-agri commodity derivatives (physically-settled positions must be exited at least 3 days before expiry, before the tender period); depository receipts for listed REITs/InvITs in overseas jurisdictions; a common advertisement code (celebrities allowed for brand/entity-level promotion, not specific products); new Settlement Regulations 2026 with 9% p.a. disgorgement interest; a ₹75 crore net-worth threshold for vault managers; widened accredited-investor norms; and relaxed corporate-debt rules.

stories.title: Bank strike 28–30 Sept: today is the last full working day
stories.body: the United Forum of Bank Unions (seven unions covering ~90% of the banking workforce) has called a 3-day nationwide strike from 28 Sept; SBI advised customers to finish branch work by 25 Sept (today); ATMs, YONO, internet/mobile banking and UPI stay functional; key demands: 5-day banking week, pension updation, uniform DA formula, NPS-to-OPS switch option; a continuous strike from 26 Oct is also on notice.

stories.title: Jaishankar chairs 2nd FIPIC Foreign Ministers' Meeting in New York
stories.body: on 24 Sept, on the sidelines of UNGA 81, EAM S. Jaishankar chaired the second Foreign Ministers' Meeting of the Forum for India–Pacific Islands Cooperation (FIPIC, platform launched 2014 in Fiji); leaders reviewed the 12-Point Action Plan announced by PM Modi in 2023 and discussed renewable energy, climate action, disaster resilience, education, healthcare and capacity building; Jaishankar endorsed the Pacific Islands Forum's 2050 Strategy for the Blue Pacific Continent and proposed tailored capacity-building programmes for Pacific professionals.

stories.title: FSSAI proposes ban on analogue paneer sold as 'paneer'
stories.body: draft Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restrictions on Sales) Amendment Regulations, 2026 (notified 22 Sept, Gazette-published 23 Sept) proposes adding "paneer made of constituents not derived from milk" to restricted products; items already licensed under 'Analogue in Dairy Context' must drop the word 'Paneer' from nomenclature, labelling and marketing; objections/suggestions invited within 60 days of Gazette publication; at least eight states (including Maharashtra, Karnataka, Gujarat) have already acted against analogue paneer at state level.

stories.title: Draft National Electricity Policy 2026 sent to Cabinet
stories.body: the Power Secretary said the Power Ministry has forwarded the draft National Electricity Policy 2026 to the Cabinet for approval.

stories.title: Railways: 2nd Saraighat rail-cum-road bridge over the Brahmaputra
stories.body: the Ministry of Railways will build the Second Saraighat Rail-cum-Road Bridge in Assam along with doubling of the Agthori–Kamakhya track, both under the Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) zone; separately, Railways approved a ₹166.5 crore four-lane ROB at Alkapuri in Vadodara and a new daily overnight train between Kanpur and Anand Vihar.

stories.title: India meets 99.2% of domestic mobile phone demand
stories.body: Electronics Secretary S. Krishnan said domestic manufacturing now meets 99.2% of India's mobile phone demand, marking a major milestone for electronics self-reliance.

stories.title: NEET-PG 2026 results declared
stories.body: the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) declared results on 24 Sept for the exam held 30 Aug 2026 (2,63,544 candidates) plus a Jaipur re-exam on 5 Sept for 2,416 candidates hit by a power failure; category cut-offs: General/EWS 262 (50th percentile), General-PwBD 244 (45th), SC/ST/OBC 226 (40th); ranks based on actual marks with tie-breaking criteria; individual scorecards and answer keys to be released on natboard.edu.in in October; the Board found none of the questions technically incorrect.

stories.title: Asian Games 2026 Day 6: five medals, India at 17
stories.body: on 24 Sept India won 2 silver and 3 bronze: mixed 4x400m relay silver (Poovamma Raju, Vishal Thennarasu, Vithya Ramraj, Manu TS); Seema Kumari bronze in women's 10,000m — India's first athletics medal of the Games; Parinaaz Dhaliwal and Anantjeet Singh Naruka bronze in skeet mixed team; Roshibina Devi silver in women's 60kg wushu; Satnam Singh and Salman Khan bronze in men's double sculls (6:13.25); India's tally rose to 17 (1 gold, 6 silver, 10 bronze) but the country slipped to 15th; China crossed the 100-medal mark on the sixth day.

stories.title: Hockey: India thrash South Korea 8-2
stories.body: India's biggest-ever win over South Korea in Asian Games history; in kabaddi, the women's team beat Japan 50-25 to reach the semifinal and the men's team beat Chinese Taipei to top the group — both assured of medals.

stories.title: World Pharmacists Day — 25 September
stories.body: the International Pharmaceutical Federation's (FIP) annual observance; 2026 theme: "Empowering pharmacists for healthier futures", highlighting pharmacists' role in prevention, access to care and health-system resilience.

stories.title: Antyodaya Diwas — 25 September
stories.body: observed on the birth anniversary of Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya to honour his Antyodaya vision — the upliftment of the last person in the queue.
